Trump-Xi summit Day 2 outcomes 15 May 2026:

- Trump and Xi agreed to develop a "constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability"
- Beijing treating this as guiding framework for next three years and beyond
- Trump said China has agreed to buy oil from the US
- China stopped short of confirming purchase of American energy
- Trade: "fantastic trade deals" per Trump
- Iran: Trump said he and Xi discussed Iran and agreed Tehran should not have a nuclear weapon
- Beijing called for reopening of shipping lanes "as soon as possible"
- Comprehensive and lasting ceasefire urged
- Trump on Fox News (re China buying US oil): China has "insatiable appetite" for energy
- Marco Rubio: US Taiwan policy "unchanged"
- Substantive agreements yet to be announced on key rivalry issues
- "Lot of different problems were settled" per Trump
